_about: Wording quality of the requests, by one rubric for both writers. Muse's notes were written at 2026-09-30T02:39 EDT, before any Qwen scenario existed (none had been saved in the writers' workspaces), from autogen_02's show_scenarios; Qwen's are added after my review with the same rubric.

rating.natural: a colleague would say it this way; conditions read as ordinary identification
rating.stilted: plausible, but conditions stacked or phrased more explicitly than a user would (reads like a spec)
rating.contrived: a user would not say it this way: identification by an unusual key or a condition that exists only to test

rubric.hint: a phrase that points the solver at the decisive check more than a user would ("not the one…", "one-to-one", "that's showing in my list")
rubric.ambiguity: a phrase readable two ways such that a near miss could meet the request (attachment, scope)
rubric.reader_flags: the cold reader's contestable flags kept on the accepted case
